name: Software
text: Code, tools and automation. Each project gets a branch with what it does, how it was built and a link to the live version.
underText: Debug journals, abandoned prototypes and the notes that explain why things were built the way they were.

projects.name: Interfaces
projects.text: Screens, interactions and the front-end work behind them. Screenshots, a short write-up and a link.
projects.underText: The bugs that took longest, what caused them and what finally fixed them.

projects.name: Automation
projects.text: Scripts and workflows that remove repeat work. What each one replaces and how much time it saves.
projects.underText: Ideas that were started and dropped, with the reason each one stopped.

name: Camper van
text: The van build, from bare shell to a place to live. Progress photos, layouts and finished systems.
underText: Measurements, load calculations and the mistakes that changed the plan.

projects.name: Electrical
projects.text: Battery bank, charging and wiring. Diagrams, parts lists and the finished system.
projects.underText: Wire gauges, fuse sizing and load math, with the corrections made along the way.

projects.name: Build-out
projects.text: Insulation, cabinetry and the bed platform. A before and after slider for each stage.
projects.underText: Cuts that were off, the templates that fixed them and what to measure twice.

name: Oil painting
text: Oil painting, the most recent medium. Finished canvases next to the studies that led to them.
underText: Underpaintings, color charts and glazes that did not work.

projects.name: Finished works
projects.text: Completed canvases with size, palette and a time-lapse of each.
projects.underText: Layers that went muddy or cracked, and what changed the next attempt.

projects.name: Studies
projects.text: Small, quick studies of light, edges and color temperature.
projects.underText: Swatches and mixing recipes pulled from each study.

name: Hydroponics
text: A hydroponic garden on a rack with a timed light and measured nutrients. Live readings and harvest photos.
underText: pH and EC logs, nutrient recipes and the plants that did not survive.

projects.name: Grow rack
projects.text: The build: reservoir, pump, light and timer. Parts list and wiring.
projects.underText: Daily readings charted over time, including the days that drifted.

projects.name: Harvests
projects.text: What came out of the rack, with dates and yields.
projects.underText: Failed seedlings and root problems, with the likely cause of each.
